title: intake's drift detector reaches every eligible item over successive runs, not the same first few
goal: Within its time budget the drift detector starts from a different eligible item on each run (a rotation keyed on the main tip, so the same inputs give the same order), so every eligible item's checks run within a bounded number of runs; a test plants more eligible items than one budget covers and shows each is checked within N runs
notes: BG-vubkpech bounded drift to a 30 s budget; on the repository it then checks the same first items in id order every run and leaves most of the eligible ones unchecked.
